answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Mortgage statement history with bank attestation flips the bet — statements showing years of on-time payments — and the sable lands on the attacker instead. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the canyon compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the nectar of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
